user: Conor uses a pixel-art habit app on his phone to quit Zyn nicotine pouches and social media, and to keep a morning routine, night routine, meditation, deep breathing, focus sessions, workouts and 7+ hours of sleep. He opens it in the morning, between tasks and at night, glances at what is left today, taps it done, reads one short coach lesson, and spends the grit he earns on his pixel garden.
hates: anything he has to decode; numbers that look wrong or disagree between screens (grit, streak, done counts, minutes, hours slept); text walls and coach jargon; instructions that look tappable or buttons that look like plain text; stale or wrong dates; rewards or toasts covering what he needs to read; empty or placeholder screens that look broken; blurry or misaligned pixel art; anything cut off or hidden behind the tab bar; being told he failed on his first day; Tabs that look like different apps (the Dojo's light-blue sky with dark rounded cards is the style he likes; plain black or white system lists elsewhere feel off); a habit with no visible reason why he should do it; adding a habit hidden away in Settings; small or fiddly tap targets, especially in the garden editor.
context: Three fixtures, all built for this test (the app has no real history yet). 'day1' is a fresh install: nothing logged, history starts today. 'week2' is 14 days of history ending today: morning routine done today; a few missed meditation, workout and deep-breathing days; two social-media slips and one nicotine slip earlier; sleep logged every night (about 6.5-8 hours, bedtimes 23:00-00:45); one 25-minute focus session today. 'month6' is about 180 days of mixed history (most habits done 55-85% of days, occasional social-media and nicotine slips, sleep logged every night with bedtimes 22:30-00:15, morning routine done today, 25- and 50-minute focus sessions today): it exists to check the app stays fast and readable with months of data, so large grit totals, levels and long lists are expected. Screens per fixture, in order: Dojo (pixel garden), the Shop sheet, the Settings sheet, the Dojo in build mode (the garden above the item tray), Today at every scroll position, Today with Workout's 'Why?' opened, Today after tapping Done on Workout, after tapping 'I did it' on today's lesson, the 'Add a habit' sheet opened from Today's +, Sleep, the sleep log sheet, Sleep after saving it, Focus, Coach at every scroll position, 'Your day' opened from Coach, then the Tip library. Expected on a simulator test, not bugs: Screen Time blocking is not set up (Settings offers 'Allow Screen Time'), the CoachSync folder is not connected, and the Today title shows the simulator's date. The simulator's clock runs on UTC and its status bar shows no AM/PM, so a time like '10:07' may be evening; judge countdowns ('1h 52m left') against the app's own day, not the status bar.
